name: Sabine Albrecht
original_name: ザビーネ・アルブレヒト
source:
"If you are not prepared to offer your body to us, then please leave."

One of the five nobles governing the Berezinsky domain, and a vampire descended from the bloodline of Chandagnac. He was one of the founders of the domain alongside Aleksandr, and he now manages its administrative duties.

[Translated from [url=https://x.com/WitchB_otomate/status/2011725044003848208]Twitter[/url]]
